frozen_rules.R1_population: The 8 rows named by worker-023 disjunctive_row_set and by the staged diff: D-004, D-005, T-303, T-305, T-402, T-515, T-526, T-528. The frozen class token set is exactly the four class ids in research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml (rev5).
frozen_rules.R2_mechanical_delta: Staged-vs-live differences must be confined to rows in the population and to fields {class_ids, informs_classes, ledger_tags}; every other field of every row must be byte-identical; 62 rows, order preserved.
frozen_rules.R3_hf02_detector: Rubric-literal HF-02 'disjunction of class_ids' = a row whose class_ids contains >= 2 frozen class tokens. Recomputed independently from both pinned files.
frozen_rules.R4_adoption_fidelity: For each population row, staged class_ids and informs_classes must equal worker-023's row.recommended values exactly, and staged ledger_tags must equal live ledger_tags plus the packet's ledger_tags_add with order preserved.
frozen_rules.R5_conditional_license: If a population row's worker-023 row has needs_f1_ruling != null, the staged bytes adopt the packet's default branch. A row is LICENSED only if an accepted-stream event after the packet created_at (2026-09-12T00:36:38+08:00) from a lead/controller actor rules the stated question. Otherwise the staged disposition is LICENSE_PENDING.
frozen_rules.R6_self_declared_scope: For a frozen class token X in a row's class_ids, X is SELF_CONTRADICTED iff one of the row's own does_not_imply strings matches the X-specific disclaimer regex: C0 -> '(does not|not) (decide|prove|settle|establish|imply).{0,60}(C\^?0|continuous)' or 'not the C\^?0 formulation' or 'any SCC formulation'; C2 -> the same with C\^?2; WCC -> '(does not|not) (decide|prove|settle|establish).{0,60}(WCC|weak cosmic censorship)'. The quote match is recorded.
frozen_rules.R7_subject_crosswalk: From the prior worker-099 census cells: subject classes = cells whose relation starts with SUBJECT_. If the prior row resolution is INTERMEDIATE_NEITHER, staged class_ids == [] is ALIGNED; otherwise the row is ALIGNED iff every subject class is in staged class_ids. All prior cell quotes are re-grounded in the pinned live row bytes (fabrication control).
frozen_rules.R8_gate_consequence: G-LIT criterion 'statement scope matched to class_id' (evaluation_rubric.yaml:140) cannot be satisfied for a row with class_ids == []. Count and enumerate such rows live vs staged, including rows with conclusion_type in {theorem, conditional_theorem}. This is a computation, not a verdict.
